cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. An open-ended duration. Do you have a guarantor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Urgency noted. Please sign without dripping on the terms.
